verdict.summary: Round 4's major consistency finding is resolved. The dedicated ZK verification-and-costs record now uses the 24,452 hidden_issuer_d4 baseline, updates the per-member table and analysis from two to four scalar multiplications, attributes the +7,506 gates to the two subgroup checks, and retains the repository-level NOT-yet-sound/external-audit caveat. The snapshot, bench mirror, catalog source/generated data, and site evidence agree on the new value. The added workflow step runs the previously uncovered non-ignored gate-count regression with nargo/bb available, while the existing test performs a real compile and bb gate-count comparison rather than a mock; the catalog test checks summary/high-gate consistency. No hostile reviewer-directed instruction was detected in the diff.
